test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the statements is correct about a compression ignition engine?

options.text: Operating speed range is less compared to petrol engine
Diesel engine produces less noise compared to petrol engine.
Starting is easy for diesel engine since less cranking effort is required compared to petrol engine.
Initial and maintenance costs of diesel engine is less compared to petrol engine

solution:
The correct answer is __Operating speed range is less compared to petrol engine**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Diesel engines__ typically operate at a lower speed range compared to petrol engines due to their design and combustion characteristics.
 
• Diesel engines are known for their higher torque at lower RPMs, making them suitable for heavy-duty applications.
 
• Unlike petrol engines, diesel engines do not use spark plugs and rely on compression ignition, which allows them to function at lower operating speeds efficiently.
 
• Although diesel engines are fuel-efficient, they produce more noise compared to petrol engines due to their higher compression ratios.
 
• Starting a diesel engine generally requires more cranking effort than a petrol engine, especially in cold conditions.
 
• Diesel engines typically involve higher initial and maintenance costs due to their robust construction and complex components.
